name: Toast
description: Brief, non-blocking message about the result of an action. Render ToastRegion once and call toast().

timeout.description: Auto-dismiss after this many ms (10 seconds by default). 0 keeps it open until the person closes it. Timers pause while the pointer is over the toast or it has keyboard focus, so nobody loses a message they are reading.

animated.description: Opt in to a fuller slide: the toast glides in from the edge and slides back out when dismissed. Off by default, which keeps the existing small rise and fade. Visitors who ask for less motion get no movement either way.

keyboard: F6 moves focus to the toast region
requirements: New toasts are announced by screen readers
Auto-dismiss pauses on hover and focus
Messages with actions should not auto-dismiss
The optional animated slide is skipped for visitors who prefer reduced motion, and never delays the message
screenReader: A new toast is announced without moving focus
F6 moves into the notifications region; the toast's title and description are read
The dismiss button is announced as Dismiss
A focused toast does not disappear while you read it

avoid_when: Errors the user must fix in a form: show them inline
anti_patterns: Several toasts at once for one action
Important info that disappears too fast
